import pandas as pd

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/training_6.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5 with Source0 on IdInterv
df = source5.merge(source0, how='left', left_on='IdInterv', right_on='IdInterv')

# Join with Source1 on IdOrigen
df = df.merge(source1, how='left', left_on='IdOrigen', right_on='IdOrigen')

# Join with Source2 on IdFactor
df = df.merge(source2, how='left', left_on='IdFactor', right_on='IdFactor')

# Join with Source3 on IdActividad
df = df.merge(source3, how='left', left_on='IdActividad', right_on='IdActividad')

# Join with Source4 on IdCausa
df = df.merge(source4, how='left', left_on='IdCausa', right_on='IdCausa')

# Join with Source6 on IdDeteccion
df = df.merge(source6, how='left', left_on='IdDeteccion', right_on='IdDeteccion')

# After joins, the columns from dimension tables (e.g. Intervencion, Origen, Factor, etc.) 
# are duplicated with suffixes. We must keep the columns from source5 only for these fields,
# because source5 already contains the string columns with correct values.
# So drop the duplicate columns from dimension tables (the ones from joined tables),
# keeping only the source5 columns for these string attributes.

# Columns to drop from joined tables (the string columns from dimension tables)
drop_cols = [
    'Intervencion_y', 'Origen_y', 'Factor_y', 'Actividad_y', 'Causa_y', 'Deteccion_y'
]

# Rename the source5 columns to original names (they have _x suffix after merge)
rename_cols = {
    'Intervencion_x': 'Intervencion',
    'Origen_x': 'Origen',
    'Factor_x': 'Factor',
    'Actividad_x': 'Actividad',
    'Causa_x': 'Causa',
    'Deteccion_x': 'Deteccion'
}

# Drop the duplicate columns if they exist
for col in drop_cols:
    if col in df.columns:
        df.drop(columns=col, inplace=True)

# Rename the source5 columns back to original names
df.rename(columns=rename_cols, inplace=True)

# The target schema expects the columns in a specific order.
# We reorder columns to match the target schema exactly.
target_columns = ['Fecha', 'Mes', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora', 
                  'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion', 
                  'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion', 
                  'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion', 
                  'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Precipitaciones', 
                  'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia', 
                  'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor', 'IdInterv', 'IdOrigen']

df = df[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_17/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
